text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Thanksgiving Festival was 
approaching. To express their gratitude to 
the fans who support them, the Umamusume 
took on various events.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro Ramonu still has many 
battles lined up against opponents of an 
even higher caliber than before. If she 
insists on dropping out, how am I supposed 
to stop her—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I shall participate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Presumably, she deemed it necessary to 
hype up the fans and generate more 
excitement for the race. ...Presumably.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It won't affect my training. Please don't 
worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, in the time leading up to the 
Fan Thanksgiving Festival—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Splendid. Now then, to the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu focuses on her daily 
training, clearing all her goals. She 
doesn't seem to be practicing for the Fan 
Appreciation Day events, however...
choice_data_list: (...I wonder what we're going to do?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, the day of the Fan Appreciation 
Festival arrived.

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fan A
text_block_list.text: W-Wah... wow! Lady Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"To think I would lay eyes upon her 
here...! Haaah, so divine..."

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fan C
text_block_list.text: Ah! Where are you going...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sister! You're here!

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That's... Lady Ardan! Lady Ramonu's 
younger sister...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "Ardan. What is that?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Our class is running an ice cream stall 
this year."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sister, would you care for some as well if 
you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Indeed, I will have some.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, u-um... Could it be that I...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Ardan-san is always so composed, 
but now she's all flustered... So cute...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea Ms. Ramonu was so 
charming... I never knew. ...I might just 
want to follow her a bit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: âRamonu.

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That is... Lady Ramonu's roommate, Symboli 
Kris S...-sama! She was participating in 
the basketball match!

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Has Lady Ramonu come to cheer this time? 
My, you two get along so well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "Looks like your team is losing."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...A formidable opponent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Right. Then, how about something like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Will you win... for my sake?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――OK. If that is what you wish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KA-CLUUUUNK!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A thunderous slam dunk from Symboli Kris 
S! And that's the final buzzer! She brings 
a come-from-behind victory to her team--!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Kris S is fixated on a single spot 
in the stands! And just what is she 
looking at—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaa!? Love~~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"This dramatic turn of events... Could it 
be the bond between Ramonu and Kris S?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I thought she'd be stuck-up and 
intimidating, but... —I see, so this is 
Lady Ramonu...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strategy to visit various places so 
people who don't know Mejiro Ramonu's 
charms can learn more about her...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Now then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an even larger crowd of fans trailing 
behind her, Mejiro Ramonu returned to the 
school gates. And then, toward the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So noisy...
choice_data_list:
Weren't you going to join the Fan 
Thanksgiving Fest...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I took part.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well then, good day to you.
choice_data_list: (Ramonu... I really don't get you at all!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Ramonu-san even has her 
Trainer dancing in the palm of her hand...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Chasing or stanning... I don't think 
I'm cut out for that kind of thing...

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu...! That's what makes her so 
exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the fans bewildered yet deeply 
impressed by her overwhelming presence, 
Mejiro Ramonu's Fan Appreciation Festival 
came to an end in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an even larger crowd of fans trailing 
behind her, Mejiro Ramonu's next stop was 
the track. And there—

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
With that, this course is now taking a 
break! Please enjoy the events at the 
other venues!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The match had just ended, and the 
spectators were on their way out.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, what should we check out next... 
wait, huh? Hey, isn't that over there...”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ramonu!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Nice breeze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still dressed in her uniform, Mejiro 
Ramonu sprinted out onto the empty track. 
Watching her figure—

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Huh, it's Mejiro Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing, such beautiful running...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――One by one, they stop in their tracks. 
And by the time she completes a lap...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every single person present was utterly 
captivated by Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Nice view.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know her true reason for coming to 
the Fan Thanksgiving Festival. But seeing 
that smile... I knew her goal had been 
accomplished.
